summary: Vendor onboarding & simultaneous SaaS license renewals: GitHub Enterprise & Datadog (contract consolidation)
description:
Issue summary:
We have two upcoming renewals (GitHub Enterprise seats and Datadog host/license plan) within three weeks. Procurement wants to evaluate onboarding a consolidated vendor billing arrangement that would combine licencing and centralize invoicing under a single vendor entity to reduce overhead and take advantage of volume discounts.

Impact:
- Finance/Eng billing: multiple invoices and manual allocation for Q2 budgets.
- Risk of service disruption if renewal/PO not approved before expiry dates.
- Potential savings opportunity if consolidated (vendor proposals estimate ~12-18% discount).

Current contracts and dates (summary):
- GitHub Enterprise (org: redwood-inference): ~120 seats, current contract expires 2026-03-25. Current annual cost ~USD 72,000 (estimate).
- Datadog (platform hosts + APM): subscription tied to account DD-RED-PLAT, contract renewal 2026-03-28. Current monthly spend ~USD 9,000 (approx), annualized ~USD 108,000.

Request (what we need from internal-support):
1) Procurement lead to coordinate vendor consolidation proposal and obtain quotes and SOWs.
2) Legal to review consolidated amendment / master services agreement (MSA) for combined billing.
3) Security to confirm required compliance artifacts (SOC2 type II, ISO27001) for vendor onboarding and validate any datasharing constraints.
4) Finance to provision a single PO flow and confirm cost-center mapping (requested cost center: ENG-PLAT, backup: FIN-OPS).

Business justification:
- Simplify billing and cost allocation across Platform & Core infra teams.
- Potential 12-18% cost savings through volume licensing and negotiated terms.
- Reduce operational overhead during future seat changes and renewals.

Attachments / Links:
- Draft vendor consolidation proposal (Google Drive): https://drive.google.com/example/procurement/RED-ONBOARD-PROPOSAL
- Current GitHub invoice excerpt (internal): /finance/invoices/GH_2025_Q4.pdf
- Datadog usage dashboard: https://app.datadoghq.com/organization/redwood-inference/dash/usage
- Related Confluence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PROC/pages/999999/License+renewal+Q2+2026

Deadline / Constraints:
- Need signed PO and vendor agreement for GitHub by 2026-03-20 to avoid auto-renew terms we cannot change.
- Datadog renewal negotiable but preferable to include in the same consolidation window (target 2026-03-22).

Proposed next steps (initial):
- Procurement to request formal quotes & SOWs from GitHub and Datadog account reps and confirm whether consolidated billing is supported.
- Security to list required artifacts and ETA for review (expected 3 business days after receipt).
- Legal to prepare a short MSA amendment template for consolidated billing.
- Finance to confirm PO template and accelerate approval path for time-sensitive renewals.

Notes: vendor onboarding may require vendor questionnaire (security), W-9 and bank details (finance), and possible updated SCCs for cross-region data.

investigation_notes: Checked current license counts in admin consoles: GitHub shows 118 active seats (2 pending invites), Datadog shows 42 hosts + 3 APM units flagged as high-usage.
Finance checked last year's invoices; no early-termination fees expected but GitHub has an automatic renewal clause that triggers default seat counts if not amended before renewal date.
Security identified that Datadog cross-account logs will need a DPA addendum for export destinations outside EU if we consolidate non-EU billing accounts.
Procurement confirmed both vendors support consolidated invoicing but require a signed agreement and updated vendor master records (W-9, bank details).
resolution_notes: Pending. Current plan: complete vendor questionnaires and legal review by 2026-03-16, obtain PO approval by 2026-03-19, sign MSA amendment and switch to consolidated billing by 2026-03-22. If any approvals are delayed, fallback will be to renew separately to avoid service disruption.
notes: This ticket is intentionally broad to coordinate multiple orgs — Procurement will spawn smaller follow-up INT tickets for each vendor-specific action (e.g., INT-9035 for GitHub PO, INT-9036 for Datadog PO) once quotes are finalized.
